teaser_441455177.altText: Mother and child walking in the terminal
teaser_441455177.description:
We're here to help make your child's journey easier and more comfortable. We support children travelling with disability and additional support needs, including:

  • autistic children,
  • children who are blind or have low vision,
  • children who are Deaf or have hearing loss,
  • children with reduced mobility, and
  • children with hidden disability.

If your child may benefit from extra support, let us know before you travel by completing our accessibility, medical and inclusion service request form.

Flying can involve new new environments and routines that may feel challenging for some children. For tips on preparing your child for air travel, including managing sensory needs and changes to routine, see Aspect Australia's guide to travelling with autistic children.

We’ve also partnered with Hidden Disabilities Sunflower to help children who may need additional support during their journey. Learn more about the Sunflower program and airport assistance.
teaser_441455177.title: Support for children with disability and additional needs
